mapper.select: Select provider, provider_id, email, role, name, exist, block From oauth_info Where provider = #{provider} And email = #{email}
mapper.insert: Insert into oauth_info (provider, provider_id, email, name) Value (#{provider}, #{providerId}, #{email}, #{name})
mapper.select: Select refresh_token From refresh_token_info Where account_id = #{id} and provider = #{provider}
mapper.update: Update refresh_token_info Set refresh_token = #{refreshToken} Where account_id = #{id} and provider = #{provider}
mapper.delete: Delete From refresh_token_info Where account_id = #{id} and provider = #{provider}
